reason: Intended difference (RDD finding A): --mask is documented to redact user identities, but Python mask() only masks role-less base64-like runs of 16+ characters, so user names (jdoe, admin, guest, station, root, the 'bad' login attempt) printed in clear. Go frames the six-string audit records (as --ops does) and prints <USER-MASKED> for every printable run overlapping a userName field, or a slotName/oldValue/value/non-slot-path target of a Login/Login Failure/Logout/Logout (Timeout) record. stdout below is the corrected expectation; the Python capture in stdout is unchanged.
